label: Generic glTF
description: Standard glTF 2.0 (meters, +Y up, front +Z). Works in any glTF viewer and in Unity (glTFast) / Unreal (Interchange) without parity guarantees.
importHints: Standard glTF 2.0 binary: 1 unit = 1 m, +Y up, the asset faces +Z, origin at the base center (unless meta.origin says otherwise).
Blender: File > Import > glTF 2.0 (.glb/.gltf). Unity: install the glTFast package and drop the .glb into Assets. Unreal Engine 5: drag the .glb into the Content Browser (Interchange glTF importer).
Materials are glTF metallic-roughness (KHR_materials_emissive_strength when emissive); faces are single-sided.

notes: Validated with the Khronos glTF validator and three.js GLTFLoader in the studio pipeline.
